details:
Setup:
I am using a Valve Index with 3 Vive trackers. Base stations and everything turn on just fine, tested with spare trackers and issue still persists. Everything is fully charged and there is nothing that should be affecting their connection. Same exact set up I've used before this update that used to work perfectly fine.
Problem:
When calibrating my fbt, the game clearly shows my trackers for my waist and feet while I am calibrating. Once I pull the triggers to calibrate, my waist tracker works fine but my feet act as if the trackers are off/not there.
Solutions I have tried:
Legacy mode - Issue still persists, but this causes my avatar's feet to be stuck together.
Turning on trackers after starting the game so that the game starts with fbt off. Doesn't work.
Turning everything off and turning it back on multiple times. Also tried just turning trackers on and off while in game. Doesn't work.
Switching avatars doesn't change anything.
Uninstalling and reinstalling the game didn't work either.
Recalibrating doesn't work.
Reassigning trackers didn't do anything either.
Playing in the Open Beta didn't fix it either.

FIXED! Keeping this up in case anyone else runs into the issue!
Setting --calibration-range="1.0" in the launch options fixed my issue, hope others find this helpful!
title: Legs for Full Body Tracking (FBT) Currently not Working with Latest Update
